scope: Bounded current primary public-document observations; no account, signup, payment or provider adoption

primary_documents.label: pinax-help
primary_documents.assessment: FAQ says eth_getLogs and eth_sendRawTransaction are unsupported, conflicting with the same provider method catalog; collapsed questions are not a numerical capacity contract.

primary_documents.label: pinax-rpc
primary_documents.assessment: Generic catalog lists standard reads, tracing, logs and submission; no reviewed Robinhood anonymous gas, byte, RPS or archive-resource cap is supplied.

primary_documents.label: pinax-call
primary_documents.assessment: Documents simulation but omits provider numerical resource and state-override contract; generic sample is not the exact EIP-1898 method evidence.

primary_documents.label: pinax-estimate
primary_documents.assessment: Generic page is labeled key required while the earlier anonymous selected-field estimate actually succeeded; no numerical full-work cap is given.

primary_documents.label: pinax-trace
primary_documents.assessment: Page describes historical/latest traces and a30s illustrative option, says Reth archive only despite actual Nitro witness; no guaranteed timeout/resource ceiling or override policy.

primary_documents.label: pinax-robinhood
primary_documents.assessment: Advertises complete archive infrastructure, but observed page still says chainID TBD; marketing is not independently checked identity or exact public-tier retention.

primary_documents.label: pinax-pricing
primary_documents.assessment: Free/Pro/Enterprise plan descriptions and usage credits are published; custom dedicated/support options are not approval of the anonymous endpoint or its numerical limits.

primary_documents.label: pinax-rpc-pricing
primary_documents.assessment: Publishes archive-oriented usage billing6USD per1M requests; does not establish trace billing weights, quota or guaranteed per-method limits.
